correctness.rationale: The five substeps of published VA-II (eqs. 2.31--2.46) reduce on the periodized one-cell cold mode to an identity first advection/Riccati pair; a solvable 2x2 midpoint system gives r_mid=R/(1+y), v1=he/(1+y), r1=R(1-y)/(1+y). The exact Riccati denominator at time h/2 is (1-3y)/(1-y). On 0<y<1 this is positive iff y<1/3, while at y=1/3 the pole occurs at endpoint and for 1/3<y<1 it occurs earlier. The final charge-conserving current equals winding-aware displacement h v1/2, giving E1=e-hv1/2. Direct substitution yields the positive physical-energy change C0 e^2 h^4/[8 R^2(1+y)^2], and r1*g1-E1=4e y^2/[(1+y)(1-3y)]. Explicit algebra proves the identities for all real parameters in scope; exact Fraction tests check independent stage calculations and pole times.
